friction_notes: All 13 supplied candidates were reviewed exactly once. Each accepted candidate retains every supplied branch ref; no candidate-specific branch, facet, context, or semantic-obligation exclusion was required.

The two trusted channel nominations are treated as pericope evidence and are expressed through exact focus or lean-context occurrence refs. Their synthesis remains an authoring inference rather than an adjudicated recurring-channel claim.

The full focus branch inventory and connection surface were inspected for uncandidate activations. Available branches without an independent contextual trigger or materially changed reader payoff remain implicit exclusions, without an exhaustive negative inventory.
